classification.difficultyReason: Use the stated diagonal to form an SSS triangle and supplement the angle using parallel sides.

content.prompt:
A parallelogram $ABCD$ has sides $AB=DC=47\text{ mm}$ and $AD=BC=29\text{ mm}$.
The longer diagonal $BD$ is $60\text{ mm}$. Find the following, round your answer to the nearest minute.

spec.description: Black parallelogram with A upper-left, B upper-right, C lower-right and D lower-left. Horizontal AB and DC; AD and BC rise to the right. Label 47 mm above AB and 29 mm outside BC. No diagonal, angle marks, equal-side marks or parallel arrows.
spec.mathematics: AB=DC=47 mm, AD=BC=29 mm; longer diagonal BD=60 mm is stated in the stem but is not drawn.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Use the cosine rule to find the size of $\angle BCD$.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Use co-interior angles to find the size of $\angle ABC$.

answer.worked:
$AB\parallel DC$, so co-interior angles sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle ABC&=180^\circ-\cos^{-1}\left(\frac{-550}{2726}\right)\\\angle ABC&\approx78^\circ22'\end{align*}$$
